assets.title: Timber Shop House with Upper Dwelling
assets.description: Original static S03 two-storey shop-house shell on a 4 x 6 m wall-centre grid. Lower display opening and fixed entry board, distinct upper dwelling windows, real floor decks, aligned timber columns, ring-and-joist upper floor, thick gables, clay roof and integral stone steps. Independent S03-SH04x06-v1 family; existing 2 m modules are dimensional references only. Door and opaque glazing are fixed. No stairs, enterable interior, floor-to-floor passage, runtime opening, animation, structural capacity or safety certification. Named child mesh identities are preserved under eleven static parent groups.
